name: Freyalise
description: A half-elven planeswalker from a bygone era and leader of elven clans who sacrificed her life to save her people.

timeline.summary: Freyalise uses her power to protect her elven clans' forest home.
timeline.quote: Freyalise was a leader of elven clans who used her incredible power to protect their forest home.

timeline.summary: Freyalise sacrifices her life to save her people, preventing a catastrophe that threatened to destroy Dominaria.
timeline.quote: She heroically sacrificed her life to save her people and prevented a catastrophe that threatened to destroy Dominaria.

pages_say.description: A half-elven planeswalker from a bygone era and leader of elven clans who sacrificed her life to save her people.
